title: Five Sentence Term Paper
text:
Introduction
The people of Madison do not take the same route to the airport.


Literature Review
An exhaustive search of the literature, lasting an intensive 0 minutes, revealed no existing empirical study of this topic.


Method

import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

table = pd.DataFrame(
    [[47, 8, 49],
     [22, 10, 21],
     [55, 59, 29]],
    index=["Madison", "Greater Madison", "Transplant"],
    columns=["Beltline", "Downtown", "Interstate"]
)
n = int(table.values.sum())

We randomly surveyed 300 residents online about their home origin and their route to the airport, then applied a chi-square test, where our null hypothesis is that route choice is not a function of home origin and our alternate hypothesis is that it is.


Results

x2, pval, degf, expected = chi2_contingency(table)
p_text = "p < .001" if pval < 0.001 else f"p = {pval:.3f}"

Our test produced an X2 statistic of 42.25 (df = 4, p < .001), so we reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternate hypothesis.


Discussion
It was good to do this work because there was previously a dearth of research on the topic, though our counts are invented, so future research should survey real residents.
